title: Megurine Luka — Between You And Me〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I brought Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hi, everyone! Thank you all for your patience!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Welcome.
That means we're all here now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm told An and the others brought snacks?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, they brought quite a lot, so we can choose whatever we like.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Woohoo! I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: These gummies are really good! They're all crunchy on the outside! Which do you two wanna have, Luka, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Wow, look at all the colors. I can't decide!
Hmm... I'll have a pink one!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, I'll have a blue one!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Mmm! These really do have a fun texture to them! Can I have another?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: These snacks have a strange flavor to them...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Strange?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They're spicy, but also sour, but it's hard to put them down... They really are strange.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: N-Now I'm curious...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: These chocolates feel kind of squishy...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're right. Could there be something inside of them? Let's eat and have a look!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, they're filled with almond cream!
They're so sweet that my head's starting to spin...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Th-They're that sweet?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They brought over so many different kinds of snacks! We really need to thank them later.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, let's do that the next time they visit.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Still, their trip to the US is already over. It sorta just flew by.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yes, it did.
After all, time does fly when you're having fun.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And thanks to them letting us come visit, it was sort of like we were traveling too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, I know what you mean!
I always got so excited going over to visit them♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Still, Luka, you were really on your best behavior during this trip...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wait, you think so?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! I mean, even before they flew over to the United States, you and KAITO talked about how you wanted to see all those different places!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, we did.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Chicago because it's the home of modern architecture and beautiful buildings! And Houston for its big space center!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: There's also Hollywood for its famous films, as well as Las Vegas!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Haha. We did do a lot of research! And then we realized that we couldn't possibly go to all those places, schedule-wise.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Really, it just didn't feel like the right atmosphere to go hang out and just goof off, though.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right. This trip was a big step toward their goal of standing on top of the world, after all. It's important.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Exactly!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I did want to see all those places we just mentioned, even just once—

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I'm satisfied because I got to see something just as good!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Just as good?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: An and the others having fun and getting all fired up about meeting some new rivals!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Rivals who are all doing everything they can to achieve the same dream...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You can tell that a new sort of competitive fire has been lit inside of them based on the way they sang!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Now I see.
Yes, that is just as good.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Working and performing overseas probably isn't going to be easy...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I am looking forward to seeing how things unfold for them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They're going over to the US again as part of making their dream come true, so we can take our time seeing all the things we want...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm...? Are you saying...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
What do you think that space center's like?
And wouldn't it be great to go to Hollywood and be in a movie?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You haven't given up at all on those things, Luka...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Of course I haven't!
I still want to see and do those things!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Honestly...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You never change, Luka.
